## Before you submit

- [ ] I made my changes in a **separate branch**, not directly on `main`
- [ ] This PR targets the `main` branch of this repository
- [ ] My PR has a **clear title** that says what it does
- [ ] I filled in the description above (and added screenshots if the UI changed)

## 💡 Tips

- **Not finished yet?** Open a **Draft PR** (use the arrow next to "Create pull request"). It's a great way to ask for early feedback. When you're ready, click "Ready for review".
- **Keep it small.** Smaller PRs are quicker to review and easier to fix.
- **Stuck?** Leave a comment on this PR and ask. Everyone starts somewhere.
